name: MEXT Scholarship
description: For Embassy Recommendation, recruitment for undergraduate students is typically held between April and May of the previous year. The exact application schedule varies by country; applicants should check the Japanese embassy or consulate in their country.

name: Türkiye Scholarships
description: Türkiye Scholarships is a government-funded scholarship program for international students. Full-time Bachelor's applications are generally accepted annually from January 10 to February 20. Applicants should check the official website for the current year's application announcement.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum
description: The Stipendium Hungaricum application is held once a year. For the 2026/2027 cycle, the application deadline was January 15, 2026 at 2:00 PM CET. The exact deadline for the next cycle should be confirmed in the new official Call for Applications.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS-U)
description: For the 2027 Global Korea Scholarship for Undergraduate Degrees (GKS-U), the Embassy Track application window is September 15–30, 2026, with the deadline at 6:00 PM Korea Standard Time. University Track has a separate application schedule; applicants should check the official 2027 GKS-U guidelines for the exact deadline.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship
description: The Chinese Government Scholarship has multiple application routes and deadlines. The opening and closing dates depend on the scholarship category, application route, and responsible institution. Applicants should check the official Campus China information and the relevant Chinese embassy or institution for the current deadline.

name: Romanian Government Scholarship
description: The Romanian Government Scholarship is offered annually to eligible non-EU applicants. For the 2026/2027 cycle, applications were accepted from February 16 to March 31, 2026. The exact dates for the next cycle should be confirmed on the official Study in Romania scholarship platform.

name: Heydar Aliyev International Education Grant
description: The Heydar Aliyev International Education Grant is an Azerbaijani government scholarship for international students. For the 2026/2027 academic year, the application deadline was April 15, 2026. The exact dates for the next cycle should be confirmed through the official Study in Azerbaijan website.

name: ICCR Scholarships
description: ICCR scholarships are administered through the A2A Scholarship Portal, with application procedures involving the Indian Mission in the applicant's country. Deadlines vary by scholarship and country. Applicants should check the official ICCR A2A portal and the relevant Indian Mission for the current cycle.

name: Study in India Institute Fee Waivers
description: Study in India does not offer a single centralized scholarship deadline. Tuition fee waivers and institute-driven scholarships are offered at the discretion of participating institutions, and application deadlines vary by institution.

name: Harvard College Financial Aid
description: Harvard College financial aid is need-based and available to international students as well as domestic students. For Regular Decision applicants, the financial aid application deadline is February 1; applicants applying Restrictive Early Action have an earlier financial aid deadline.

name: MIT Undergraduate Financial Aid
description: MIT undergraduate financial aid is available to international students. For prospective Regular Action applicants, the financial aid application deadline is February 15. Early Action applicants have an earlier financial aid deadline.

name: Princeton Undergraduate Financial Aid
description: Princeton undergraduate financial aid is need-based and includes financial aid application requirements for international applicants. For Regular Decision applicants, the Princeton Financial Aid Application deadline is February 1.

name: Yale Undergraduate Financial Aid
description: Yale provides need-based financial aid to international undergraduate students. For the 2027–2028 academic year, the financial aid priority deadline for Regular Decision applicants is February 15, 2027. International Early Action applicants have an earlier deadline of December 1, 2026.

name: University of Tokyo Scholarships
description: The University of Tokyo offers multiple scholarships and financial support programs, and application periods vary by scholarship, faculty, and admission route. Applicants should check the official University of Tokyo scholarship or financial support page for the specific program and intake.

name: Kyoto University Scholarships
description: Kyoto University offers multiple scholarships and financial support programs. Application procedures and deadlines vary by scholarship, faculty, and admission route. Applicants should check the official Kyoto University information for the specific program.

name: Tohoku University Scholarships
description: Tohoku University is introducing the International Excellence Scholarship for international students enrolling from the 2027 academic year, including undergraduate students. Selection is connected to entrance examination results or academic performance and other criteria, and no separate scholarship application deadline has been announced.

name: Osaka University Scholarships
description: Osaka University offers multiple scholarships, tuition exemptions, and financial support programs for international students. Application periods vary by scholarship, faculty, and student status. Applicants should check the official Osaka University information for the relevant program.

name: Nagoya University Scholarships
description: For Nagoya University G30 undergraduate admissions for 2027, the first application round closes November 19, 2026 and the second round opens January 5 and closes January 21, 2027. Scholarship consideration is connected to the relevant admission process.

name: Waseda University Scholarships
description: Waseda University offers multiple internal and external scholarships for international students. Application timing varies by scholarship and academic department, and some scholarships are available only after enrollment or through faculty selection.

name: KAIST International Student Scholarship
description: KAIST provides an international undergraduate scholarship through the admission process rather than a separate scholarship application. For 2027 admissions, application deadlines differ by admission round, including an earlier round in October 2026 and a regular deadline in January 2027.

name: POSTECH International Scholarships
description: POSTECH provides scholarship support to eligible international undergraduate students through the international admissions process. Admission and scholarship schedules vary by intake, so applicants should check the official POSTECH international admissions information for the current intake.

name: Yonsei International Student Scholarships
description: Yonsei University offers multiple scholarships and financial support options for international undergraduate students. For Spring 2027 international admission, the online application period was September 1–17, 2026. Individual scholarship conditions and schedules may differ.

name: Seoul National University Scholarships
opens: Varies by scholarship and admission intake
closes: Varies by scholarship and admission intake
description: Seoul National University offers multiple scholarship and financial support programs for international students. Eligibility and application schedules vary by scholarship and admission intake. Applicants should check the official SNU admissions and scholarship information for the relevant program.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships
description: Australia Awards Scholarships have country-specific eligibility, study fields, and application dates. Applicants should check the official Australia Awards information for their country and the current application cycle.

name: Monash International Scholarships
description: Monash University offers multiple international scholarships and awards. Some are assessed automatically through the admission process, while others have separate applications and deadlines. Applicants should check the specific scholarship for the relevant intake.

name: University of Melbourne Scholarships
description: The University of Melbourne offers multiple international scholarships for undergraduate students. Some scholarships are assessed automatically through admission, while others have separate eligibility requirements and application deadlines. Applicants should check the specific scholarship for the relevant intake.

name: University of Sydney Scholarships
description: The University of Sydney offers multiple international scholarships with different eligibility criteria and application schedules. Some awards have specific rounds while others are linked to admission or automatic assessment. Applicants should check the individual scholarship for its current deadline.

name: ANU International Scholarships
opens: Varies by scholarship and admission route
description: The Australian National University offers multiple scholarships for international students. Application procedures and deadlines vary: some awards are considered automatically through admission, while others require a separate application.

name: University of Queensland Scholarships
description: The University of Queensland offers multiple scholarships for international undergraduate students. Some scholarships are assessed automatically during admission, while others have separate application periods. Applicants should check the specific scholarship for the current deadline.

name: University of Toronto International Awards
description: The University of Toronto offers multiple international undergraduate awards with different deadlines and application procedures. Some awards are connected to admission, while others require separate applications or nominations. Applicants should check the specific award for the current deadline.

name: UBC International Scholars Program
description: For the September 2027 intake, the UBC International Scholars Program application opens in early October 2026. International applicants must apply to UBC and submit the International Scholars Program award application by November 15, 2026.

name: McGill International Entrance Scholarships
description: McGill offers major entrance scholarships to eligible undergraduate applicants. For applicants studying outside Canada, the scholarship application deadline is January 21, 2027. Applicants must also meet the applicable McGill admission deadline and submit required supporting documents.

name: University of Amsterdam Scholarships
description: The University of Amsterdam offers multiple scholarships with different eligibility requirements and deadlines. Applicants should check the official scholarship page for their specific degree programme and scholarship before applying.

name: Leiden University Scholarships
description: Leiden University offers multiple scholarships for international students. Deadlines vary by scholarship and Master's programme. For example, the Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS) has a February 1 deadline for eligible Master's programmes starting in September.

name: TU Delft Scholarships
opens: Varies by scholarship and Master's programme
closes: Varies by scholarship and Master's programme
description: TU Delft offers multiple scholarships for international Master's students. Eligibility and deadlines depend on the specific scholarship and Master's programme. Applicants should check the official TU Delft scholarship page for the relevant programme and intake.

name: Trinity College Dublin Scholarships
description: Trinity College Dublin offers multiple scholarships for international undergraduate students, including the Global Excellence Undergraduate Scholarships and region-specific awards. Eligibility, award value, and deadlines vary by scholarship.

name: UCD Global Excellence Scholarships
description: UCD Global Excellence Scholarships are available to eligible international students who hold an offer or conditional offer for an eligible programme. Application deadlines vary by region, and applicants should check the current regional terms and conditions on the official UCD Global website.

name: University College Cork Scholarships
description: University College Cork offers multiple scholarships and awards for international students. Some undergraduate scholarships are assessed automatically, while others have separate application processes and deadlines. Applicants should check the specific UCC scholarship for current details.

name: University of Glasgow International Scholarships
description: The University of Glasgow offers multiple international scholarships with different eligibility criteria and application procedures. Some awards are automatic while others require separate applications. Deadlines vary by scholarship; for example, the Undergraduate Talent Scholarships are scheduled to reopen in October 2026 for the 2027/2028 academic year.

name: University of Manchester International Scholarships
description: The University of Manchester offers multiple international scholarships for undergraduate and postgraduate students. For the 2027 Global Futures Scholarships, eligibility and application deadlines differ by country or region. Applicants should check the official country profile and scholarship terms for the applicable deadline.

name: University of Edinburgh Scholarships
description: The University of Edinburgh offers multiple scholarships and funding schemes for international undergraduate students. Scholarship deadlines vary by award. For 2027 undergraduate entry, the main UCAS equal-consideration deadline is January 13, 2027 for most programmes, but individual scholarships may have separate deadlines.

name: UCL Scholarships
description: UCL offers multiple scholarships and funding schemes for international undergraduate students, with different eligibility requirements and deadlines. For 2027 undergraduate entry, the UCAS deadline for most UCL courses is January 13, 2027, while individual scholarships may have separate application deadlines.

name: Chevening Scholarships
description: Chevening is the UK Government's international scholarship programme for one-year master's study in the UK. For the 2027–2028 cycle, applications opened on August 4, 2026 and close on October 6, 2026 at 11:00 UTC. The Algeria country page confirms that applications are open in Algeria.

name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
description: The France Excellence Eiffel programme supports international students at Master's and Doctoral level. For the 2026 campaign, applications were submitted by French higher education institutions and the Campus France deadline was January 8, 2026. The programme provides a monthly allowance and additional benefits, but tuition fees are not covered by the Eiffel programme itself. The 2026 campaign is closed.

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
description: Knight-Hennessy Scholars is a multidisciplinary graduate scholarship at Stanford University. The 2027 cohort application closes on October 6, 2026 at 1:00 PM Pacific Time. Scholars receive funding for up to three years, including tuition and associated fees, a living and academic stipend, and a travel stipend for one annual trip to and from Stanford.

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
description: For applicants from Algeria, the 2027–2028 Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships offer Research Fellowship and PhD scholarship categories. Applications opened on August 20, 2026 and close on November 13, 2026 at 11:59 PM Swiss local time. The scholarship provides CHF 2,450 per month plus additional benefits, while tuition and semester fees are not covered by the federal scholarship.

name: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme
description: The Helmut-Schmidt-Programme supports master's study in selected programmes related to public policy and good governance. The 2026 application deadline was July 31, 2026. Scholarship holders receive €992 per month, a study and research grant, travel support, insurance, and other allowances. Tuition fees are waived, although semester registration fees may still apply. The 2027 application deadline has passed.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are international master's programmes delivered by consortia of universities. Students from around the world can apply, and selected programmes offer full scholarships covering participation costs and contributing to travel, visa and living expenses. A new batch of programmes is added each year, and most applications are submitted between October and January.

name: Reach Oxford Scholarship
description: The Reach Oxford Scholarship supports undergraduate students from eligible low-income countries, including Algeria. It covers course fees, a grant for living costs and one return air fare per year for three or four years depending on the course. Applicants must first apply to Oxford and receive an offer before they can be considered for the scholarship.

name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
description: The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship is a four-year undergraduate scholarship for international students entering the University of Toronto in September 2027. It covers tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support. For the 2027 entry cycle, schools must nominate students by October 9, 2026, the U of T admission application deadline is October 16, 2026, and the scholarship application deadline is November 6, 2026.

name: UBC International Scholars Program
description: UBC's International Scholars Program supports international undergraduate students with outstanding academic achievement, leadership and significant financial need. Applications for the September 2027 intake open in early October 2026 and the award application is due November 15, 2026. Applicants must first apply for admission to UBC and obtain a school nomination and referee recommendations. One award category can provide support up to the full cost of the academic programme and living expenses.
